translations.web: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?
translations.bsb: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
translations.kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
translations.asv: Else what shall they do that are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why then are they baptized for them?
